name: Search Files
description: Search for files in Microsoft Sharepoint. [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/search-query?view=graph-rest-1.0&tabs=http)

configurable_props.name: queryString
configurable_props.label: Query String
configurable_props.description: The search query containing the search terms

configurable_props.name: queryTemplate
configurable_props.label: Query Template
configurable_props.description: Provides a way to decorate the query string. Supports both KQL and query variables. Example: `({searchTerms}) AuthorOWSUSER:Adventure` [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/search-concept-query-template) for more information.

configurable_props.name: select
configurable_props.label: Select
configurable_props.description: A comma-separated list of properties to return in the response

configurable_props.name: size
configurable_props.label: Max Results
configurable_props.description: The maximum number of results to return

configurable_props.name: sortField
configurable_props.label: Sort Field
configurable_props.description: The field to sort the results by

configurable_props.name: descending
configurable_props.label: Descending
configurable_props.description: Whether to sort the results in descending order
